Coffee & food

What is on the table

From what guests write in their Google reviews.

Coffee and tea

Good coffee, a wide choice of teas and drinks for those who do not want coffee, such as the London Fog tea latte.

Pumpkin soup

12 reviews mention the pumpkin soup, made with lentils, ginger and lemon. One guest calls it the best soup they ever ate.

Homemade cakes

Homemade orange pie and apple pie, cakes, sweets and fresh cookies.

Light food

Soups, homemade snacks and sandwiches, with many healthy and vegan options.

Umbrellas, soup and a cat

Photos from the Google listing of Lala Cafe.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Lala the cat

The café is named after its cat Lala. Guests love the cat decorations everywhere, and the café is pet friendly.

Books to borrow

Shelves full of books you can borrow, and books hanging from the ceiling.

Good for working

Many guests come with a laptop to work or study, and stay for the music and the calm atmosphere.

A cosy corner in the city

Lala Cafe on Stasinou Avenue in Akropoli, formerly Second Cup Acropolis, has been here since 2013. Floral armchairs, bookshelves, umbrellas on the ceiling and a cat asleep on the cushions. Open every day from 08:00.

What guests say

Three of 328 Google reviews, 241 of them with five stars.
